document.description:
Modified version of the reconciliation demonstration pair. Compute intent is authored without an operating system or virtualization mechanism, the scenario imports no modules, and nothing regenerates per run or per instantiation, so the pair plans offline and deterministically against the reference dry-run manifest.
Against the baseline's planned state this version creates `cache`, updates `database` and — through a refresh dependency, with an identical payload — its health condition, deletes `retired`, and leaves everything else unchanged.
